_ordering_rationale: Ordre PV decroissante. CA total (hero), comp sales (signal demand), net earnings, diluted EPS, ROIC (excellence allocation capital), nombre magasins (footprint), avg ticket.

kpis.signal: CA LOW rebond 2025 +3%, premier exercice positif depuis 2022, momentum Pro + acquisitions FBM/ADG
kpis.description_fr: CA total Lowe's (exercice fiscal cloture fin janvier). Fiscal 2022 = 53 semaines. 2023-2025 baisse puis stabilisation post-pic COVID.
kpis.description_en: Lowe's total net sales (fiscal year ending late January). Fiscal 2022 = 53 weeks. 2023-2025 declines then stabilization post-COVID peak.

kpis.signal: Comps positifs 2025 (+0.2%) apres 3 ans de declin, signal de retournement marche home improvement
kpis.description_fr: Croissance ventes a magasins comparables (open >13 mois). Indicateur cl industrie retail. 2025 = inflexion positive +0.2% (ticket +3.0%, transactions -2.8%).
kpis.description_en: Comparable store sales growth (open >13 months). Key retail metric. 2025 = positive inflection +0.2% (ticket +3.0%, transactions -2.8%).

kpis.signal: Resultat net LOW -4% en 2025, sous pression mix produit + investissements, marge nette ~7.7%
kpis.description_fr: Resultat net Lowe's. Marge nette 2025 = 7.71% (vs 8.31% 2024, 8.95% 2023). Note: 2023 reporte = 7726 (incluant cession Canada partielle).
kpis.description_en: Lowe's net earnings. 2025 net margin = 7.71% (vs 8.31% 2024, 8.95% 2023). Note: 2023 = 7726 (incl. partial Canada divestment).

kpis.signal: BPA dilue 2025 = 11.85 $, baisse moindre que NI grace buybacks (-3% vs -4%), capital return continu
kpis.description_fr: Earnings per share dilue Lowe's. Soutenu par buybacks agressifs (3,929 M$ rachats actions 2024, 6,334 M$ en 2023).
kpis.description_en: Lowe's diluted EPS. Supported by aggressive buybacks (3,929M repurchases in 2024, 6,334M in 2023).

kpis.signal: ROIC LOW 26.1% en 2025, en baisse mais reste excellent (>20%), levier dette + capital return
kpis.description_fr: Return on Invested Capital. Mesure non-GAAP cl LOW. 2025 baisse a 26.1% (vs 32.0% 2024) reflete acquisitions FBM/ADG + pression marges.
kpis.description_en: Return on Invested Capital. Key LOW non-GAAP metric. 2025 drops to 26.1% (vs 32.0% 2024) reflecting FBM/ADG acquisitions + margin pressure.

kpis.signal: Footprint LOW 1,759 magasins en 2025 (+11 nets), strategie ouvertures ciblees apres rationalisation Canada 2022
kpis.description_fr: Nombre total magasins retail Lowe's a la cloture exercice. 2022 = exit Canada (-200 magasins). 2025 = nouvelles ouvertures.
kpis.description_en: Total Lowe's retail stores at fiscal year-end. 2022 = Canada exit (-200 stores). 2025 = new openings.

kpis.signal: Ticket moyen 106.13 $ en 2025, hausse +3.1% reflete mix Pro + inflation moderee, premiere acceleration depuis 2022
kpis.description_fr: Panier moyen par transaction Lowe's. Driver mix produit + pricing. 2025 acceleration +3.1% via mix Pro favorable.
kpis.description_en: Average ticket per transaction Lowe's. Mix + pricing driver. 2025 acceleration +3.1% via favorable Pro mix.
